conditional_diagnostic.premise: Hypothetically bound every matching LL/SC compare/exchange invocation to at most two failed store-conditionals; no selected Linux profile establishes this premise.

exclusions: No LL/SC profile is promoted to a kernel progress property by this capability audit.
The hypothetical two-failure bound is diagnostic only and is not asserted of any CPU, emulator, compiler output or kernel configuration.

Native LSE and Zacas subpaths do not promote their mixed runtime-selectable ARM64 and RISC-V profiles while an unaccepted LL/SC path remains possible; the LoongArch final-put AMO likewise does not promote its LL/SC get path, and the MIPS32r2 mapping has only LL/SC paths.
No scheduler fairness, unbounded lock-free progress, wait-freedom, interrupt/NMI progress, RCU progress or whole-kernel liveness is claimed.

profiles.blocking_reason: The configured object contains both an LSE CAS path and an LL/SC retry path selected by CPU capability; the profile is without an established finite exclusive-store failure bound.
The configured object contains both a Zacas AMOCAS path and an LR/SC retry path selected at runtime; the profile is without an established finite store-conditional failure bound.
The selected LDREX/STREX compare/exchange retries after exclusive-store failure without a profile-bound finite failure guarantee.
The selected LWARX/STWCX compare/exchange retries after reservation loss without a profile-bound finite failure guarantee.
The selected MOVLI/MOVCO compare/exchange retries after conditional-store failure without a profile-bound finite failure guarantee.
The selected LDL_L/STL_C compare/exchange retries through a compiler subsection trampoline after conditional-store failure without a profile-bound finite failure guarantee.

The selected LoongArch LL.W/SC.W get compare/exchange retries after conditional-store failure without a profile-bound finite failure guarantee; the AMO final-decrement path does not establish get-loop progress.
The selected MIPS32r2 LL/SC compare/exchange retries after conditional-store failure without a profile-bound finite failure guarantee.
